params.text: Three friends, an elephant, a bird and a bee, are on an adventure to build a playground. Look!
What a BIG bucket you have. Said the bee. All the better to collect water with! MY water! MY water! Go away! Go away! Said the duck. One, two, three friends move on without delay  in their boat.
What a BIG web you have! Said the bird. All the easier to stop you with! MY water! MY water! Go away! Go away! Said the spider.
Ok, ok, ok! Said the elephant carrying their boat. One, two, three friends move on without delay. Where did the basket go?
Look! Is this a dragon?
What a BIG mouth you have! And what sharp teeth! All the better to eat you with! MY water! MY water! Go away! Go away! Shouts the dragon. Then suddenly …
… It gets darker and darker … … and the waves get bigger and bigger. They splash and they crash.
Oh no! Help! Help! Screams the bee. Help! Shouts the ant clinging on the piece of wood. Big waves, everywhere
Help! Shouts the dragon. Hold on! I've got you! Says the elephant. Help! Help! Says the spider.
Watch! Watch! Big wave! Big wave!  I'll get it!  Shouts the dragon.
That was so close. We are safe now! But where is our basket?
One, two, three, four, five, six friends build a playground.
Having fun! Together. And who is sleeping? Look! A new friend?

“Together” credits
This work, “Together“ by GOGN picture book was supported by a Global OER Graduate Network (GOGN) Fellowship in 2020.  The illustrations are a remix of details of exhibits from the Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam available under CC0 and new illustrations.
